formula_specification: Empirical Viral Score (VS): VS = w1*(likes/reach) + 2.5*w2*(shares/reach) + 2.0*w3*(saves/reach) + 1.5*w4*(comments/reach) * decay_factor
scientific_limitation_notice: The current 1,000-record dataset originates from app store consumer reviews, which do not contain post-level Instagram interaction telemetry (likes, comments, shares, views). An empirical viral score CANNOT be claimed without true interaction logs.
